displayName: OCI-AI-DB-029: AI — Vector Database Credential Theft
description:
Detects credential theft targeting vector database authentication mechanisms

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_029", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" IN ('CreateDatabase', 'UpdateDatabase', 'DeleteDatabase', 'RestoreAutonomousDatabase', 'FailoverAutonomousDatabase') AND "value" > 0
